Commit `9e2b1c16e72d3624ac0fdf579a0429114b2d65aa` promotes the scene presenter to the default startup path by making `DefaultRenderBackendFactory.makeBatchBackend()` unconditional in `Sources/SwiftWindowsRendererD3D11/DefaultRenderBackendFactory.swift:14`, then teaching `WinSwiftUIWindowHost` to select scene by default, honor `SWIFT_WINDOWSUI_FRAME_DEBUG`, record presenter-selection state, and emit startup probe payloads in `Sources/WinSwiftUI/App.swift:119-128`, `638-663`, and `709-752` plus the new startup-selection types in `Sources/WinSwiftUI/PresentationStartup.swift:4-100`. `Sources/SwiftWindowsPlatform/Win32Host.swift:237-243` adds the close request used by one-shot startup probes, `Tests/SwiftWindowsCoreLogicTests/WinSwiftUIWindowHostTests.swift:1649-1778` proves default scene startup, explicit frame-debug startup, and downgrade observability through the real host seam, and `Tests/SwiftWindowsCoreLogicTests/IntegrationTests.swift:457-460` updates the factory expectation to the promoted default. I found no blocking correctness, regression, or missing-evidence issues within this feature's scope; the handoff's demo-probe evidence covers the default-scene and explicit-frame launch assertions for VAL-RENDER-005 and VAL-RENDER-006.
